text: Show that the model's invariant holds regardless of which view attempts the change. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: void add(int n) { if (___) throw ___; value += n; }
explanation: Verified: `would go negative` then 5. The rule lives in the model, so it holds no matter which view, listener, or test attempts the change — where in the store-it-in-a-label version it would have to be duplicated in every handler that modifies the count, and one of them would eventually be missed.
